title: IP Translation and Filing Client Care Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para IP Translation and Filing Client Care Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

IP Translation and Filing Client Care Specialist


Sun IP is a global leader in patent translation, foreign filing, and annuity solutions, helping intellectual property professionals protect innovation worldwide. We are looking for a motivated, process-focused, IP-knowledgeable Client Care Specialist to join our Filings and Translations department — a collaborative team dedicated to delivering exceptional service to a sophisticated global clientele.


Success in this role demands genuine IP knowledge and a meticulous eye for detail. You will be working across a high volume of concurrent matters, each with its own instructions, deadlines, and data requirements — so the ability to prioritize accurately and act before things escalate is essential. You will take a proactive approach to every interaction: anticipating what a client needs, ensuring records are complete and correct, and entering data with the precision that IP demands. This is not a reactive role. It is one where staying ahead of the work, asking the right questions early, and keeping every case moving is what defines a great day.


This is a role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and takes genuine satisfaction in getting the details right. You will manage multiple matters simultaneously across a diverse client base, bringing IP expertise, sharp judgment, and a client-first mindset to everything you do.


Main Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of global IP clients, handling enquiries with professionalism, accuracy, and a proactive approach to resolution.
  • Process patent translation requests in connection with international filings, ensuring all instructions are interpreted correctly and actioned without delay.
  • Manage client correspondence across high-volume shared inboxes, triaging and prioritizing matters according to urgency and deadline sensitivity.
  • Enter and maintain accurate data within our workflow management platform, upholding data integrity at every stage.
  • Follow up with clients on outstanding filing requirements, documentation, and approaching deadlines — anticipating gaps before they become issues.
  • Analyze complex filing instructions and translate them into clear, actionable tasks for internal teams, removing ambiguity and keeping matters on track.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Project Management, Accounting, Sales, and other departments to coordinate client deliverables and resolve escalations.
  • Identify and resolve inconsistencies or errors in client instructions, escalating where necessary and always keeping the client informed.
  • Produce and manipulate reports in Microsoft Excel to support internal tracking, client updates, and workflow oversight.
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by sharing process insights and supporting broader team and company objectives.
  • Manage proactive client contact, ensuring clients are kept informed at every stage of their matters and no update is left outstanding.
  • Act as primary contact for client profile management, maintaining accurate account records, preferences, and filing instructions across all platforms.
  • Lead client onboarding, guiding new clients through Sun IP’s processes, systems, and service offering to ensure a confident and informed start.
  • Deliver virtual training sessions for clients, equipping them with the knowledge to work effectively with our team and tools.


Required Experience

  • Prior experience in the patent filing industry; experience as a patent filing paralegal is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrable experience processing patent translation requests in connection with international patent filings.
  • Hands-on experience with docketing systems or similar workflow management platforms.
  • Experience managing client-facing communication around filing requirements, deadlines, and documentation.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills - you can explain things clearly and confidently, whether in email, one-to-one call, or group meeting.


Skills & Competencies

-IP Knowledge & Process Orientation

  • Solid, working understanding of the patent filing lifecycle, related documentation requirements, and the implications of missed deadlines.
  • Ability to parse and act on complex filing instructions quickly and accurately, translating technical requirements into clear, step-by-step tasks.
  • A process-first mindset: you follow established workflows, flag deviations, and continuously look for ways to improve efficiency without sacrificing quality.


-Client Focus & Communication

  • Genuine commitment to client service — you take ownership of queries, communicate proactively, and never let a matter fall through the cracks.
  • Professional written and verbal communication skills, including polished client-facing email correspondence and confident participation in meetings.
  • Calm and composed under pressure, with the ability to manage urgent, time-sensitive matters without compromising accuracy or client experience.


-Organization & Problem Solving

  • Exceptional attention to detail: you spot errors, inconsistencies, and omissions that others miss, and you act on them decisively.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with a proven ability to manage a high volume of concurrent matters across varying deadlines.
  • Confident problem-solver who identifies root causes, considers options, and implements solutions - escalating only where genuinely necessary.
  • Ability to manage high-volume shared inboxes effectively, ensuring timely, organized, and consistent responses.


-Technical Proficiency

  • Accurate and efficient data entry.
  • Proficiency across multiple software platforms and case management systems; comfortable onboarding to new tools quickly.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including creating, manipulating, and interpreting reports.
  • Team-oriented and collaborative, with a genuine commitment to supporting colleagues and shared outcomes.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Mindhive Global is a New Zealand based, AI-driven technology company, operating at global scale. Using advanced machine vision and bespoke AI models, the company enables tanneries to grade hides accurately from wet-blue to finished leather and identify defects with greater accuracy and consistency than manual inspection. This verified quality data supports stronger supplier negotiations, improves traceability, and informs strategic decisions. By optimising order fulfillment and quality control, Mindhive Global helps customers increase efficiency, reduce waste, and build more resilient supply chains.


The Role

This is not a SaaS helpdesk role! It is TAM flavoured role, not a pure relationship role.


You will own the day-to-day success of a small portfolio of large, multi-year contracted enterprise accounts - each operating across multiple sites in multiple countries. You'll work across the full stack: hardware-enabled software deployments in industrial environments, platform adoption, data analysis, executive QBRs, and commercial expansion. You'll be the person who makes Mindhive's verified hide data deliver measurable business value for customers — and who documents and proves that it does.


In practice, that means:

  • Owning the full customer relationship across every stakeholder layer — from site operators on the production floor to executive sponsors in the boardroom — and building multi-threaded coverage so no account is ever dependent on a single contact
  • Driving onboarding and implementation as the primary customer contact, working alongside Field Operations through installation and onboarding, with a target of time-to-value under six months
  • Analysing operational and customer data site by site, translating findings into clear insights for both customer and internal audiences — and always validating findings against the customer's operational reality before presenting them
  • Running Quarterly Business Reviews with executive sponsors, owning the value realisation narrative, and documenting ROI in a form customers can take directly into their own internal reporting
  • Maintaining a five-dimension customer health dashboard — Relationship, Business Value, Operational Delivery, Adoption, and Commercial Momentum — and flagging risks before they escalate
  • Surfacing expansion opportunities — additional sites, new product lines, geographic rollouts — and handing them to Commercial with enough context to act
  • Supporting renewal preparation 12–18 months in advance, with a documented value summary and business case


You'll report directly to the Chief Customer Officer (who is based in Auckland New Zealand), and work alongside Commercial, Field Operations, and Product.


What this role requires

  • Fluent English: written and spoken; all customer and internal work is conducted in English;

(additional languages preferred, especially Portuguese)

  • Demonstrated experience managing more than three enterprise customers simultaneously , across multiple countries. If your experience is domestic or single-account, this role is not the right fit
  • Experience with large, strategic accounts on multi-year contracts: you understand how enterprise relationships are built and protected over time
  • Technical fluency in hardware-enabled software environments: you can engage credibly with IT and operations teams, understand system integrations, and interpret operational data without needing a translator
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% internationally (Brazil, Argentina, UK, Germany, and expanding)
  • Ability to work as a full-time independent contractor, invoicing a New Zealand company


What will make you stand out

  • Background in sectors where technology is deployed into physical operational environments: manufacturing, food processing, mining, logistics, utilities, or similar
  • Experience with hardware + software deployments (definitely NOT pure SaaS)
  • Data analytics capability: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent
  • Active, daily use of AI tools to improve your own output and analysis quality
  • Familiarity with formal customer success frameworks and methodologies


What you'll be measured on

Relationship health, documented ROI delivered for each account, platform adoption rates, onboarding time-to-value, and commercial expansion. You'll own the full customer health picture — not just satisfaction scores.


Compensation

Competitive, commensurate with experience. Paid in USD as a contractor engagement.

title: Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Nós, da Knewin , somos líderes na América Latina quando se trata de ajudar empresas e marcas a gerenciar sua reputação e presença online através de análises de dados. Com mais de 2.000 clientes, nosso objetivo é conectar nossos parceiros com seu público-alvo, visando conquistar sua preferência e alcançar resultados excepcionais para seus negócios. Valorizamos uma cultura que prioriza a agilidade, a flexibilidade e a satisfação do cliente, enquanto acreditamos no potencial transformador da tecnologia, do conhecimento e, principalmente, das pessoas.


Estamos buscando uma Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR para compor o time de Pessoas da Knewin. Nessa posição, você será responsável por garantir que nossa estrutura de remuneração seja competitiva, justa e sustentável — ao mesmo tempo em que transforma dados de RH em inteligência estratégica para o negócio. É uma vaga para quem une rigor analítico com visão de processos, e que se interessa genuinamente por automação e pelo uso prático de IA no dia a dia de RH.


Se você gosta de trabalhar com dados, entende de remuneração e quer atuar em um ambiente onde tecnologia e pessoas caminham juntas, essa posição é para você!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estrutura de Cargos e Salários: Administrar e manter a estrutura de cargos e salários da organização, garantindo a atualização contínua de tabelas, faixas, políticas e critérios de movimentação interna;
  • Análises e Movimentações Salariais: Conduzir análises salariais para subsidiar decisões de promoções, enquadramentos e ajustes, propondo alternativas alinhadas às diretrizes de remuneração e ao orçamento da companhia;
  • Ciclos de Mérito e Calibração: Conduzir os ciclos anuais de mérito, promoções e calibração salarial, garantindo consistência, equidade e aderência às políticas internas;
  • Pesquisas Salariais e Inteligência de Mercado: Conduzir pesquisas de mercado e estudos comparativos, identificando oportunidades para melhorar a competitividade da remuneração e embasando propostas de revisão de política;
  • Descrições de Cargo: Manter e evoluir as descrições de cargo da organização, apoiando lideranças na definição clara de responsabilidades, requisitos e escopo das posições;
  • Remuneração Variável e Programas de Incentivo: Apoiar no desenho e revisão de políticas de Remuneração Variável (ICP, bônus, comissões) e programas de incentivo, contribuindo para a efetividade dos mecanismos de reconhecimento;
  • People Analytics e Dashboards: Desenvolver e manter indicadores de RH, estruturar bases de dados e construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos que transformem dados em insumos relevantes para a tomada de decisão;
  • Automação e IA aplicada ao RH: Apoiar na identificação, desenvolvimento e implementação de automações e soluções com Inteligência Artificial voltadas aos processos de RH, contribuindo para a evolução e escala da área;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Propor melhorias contínuas em práticas, políticas e processos de remuneração e gestão de dados, com visão sistêmica e foco em resultados.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Psicologia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada em Remuneração, Estrutura de Cargos e Salários e análises organizacionais;
  • Domínio avançado de Excel e/ou Google Sheets;
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e indicadores em ferramentas de BI (Looker Studio ou similares);
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados, identificar tendências e gerar insights para suporte à decisão.


Também é legal se você tiver:


  • Vivência com People Analytics e governança de dados de RH;
  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia ou ambientes de startup;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de automação e aplicações práticas de Inteligência Artificial;
  • Experiência em modelos de trabalho remoto ou híbrido.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesperson em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Overview

Full Spectrum Search Group is a national healthcare recruiting firm focused on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice.

We are hiring a Recruiter to execute on active searches and drive candidate engagement across our client portfolio. This role is responsible for identifying, engaging, and advancing top talent through the interview process.

This is a phone-first, outbound recruiting role. Success in this position is driven by the ability to engage passive candidates and turn initial outreach into meaningful conversations.

If you are competitive, relationship-driven, and motivated by results, this role is for you.

About the Role

This role sits at the core of our recruiting execution. You will partner with leadership and work closely with the operations and research team to identify and engage candidates for active searches.

This is a production-driven role. Your success is measured by activity, candidate quality, and your ability to move candidates through the hiring process.

There is a steep but rewarding learning curve. You will be expected to quickly learn both our recruiting process and the nuances of the post-acute healthcare industry, including terminology, roles, and market dynamics.

Professional development is a core part of this role. The individuals who succeed here are those who actively invest in learning, improving, and refining their craft.

Candidate Sourcing and Outreach

  • Proactively identify and engage passive candidates through outbound calling, LinkedIn, CRM databases, referrals, and targeted call sheets
  • Prioritize phone-based outreach as the primary method of engagement, including calling candidates at their place of work when appropriate
  • Utilize call lists and target data provided by the research team to execute structured outreach campaigns
  • Supplement outreach with LinkedIn messaging, email, and text to increase response rates
  • Manage and respond to inbound candidates (Indeed, LinkedIn, referrals), while maintaining a primary focus on outbound recruiting

Candidate Qualification and Assessment

  • Conduct high-quality screening calls with both outbound (passive) and inbound candidates
  • Ask targeted, thoughtful questions to uncover experience, motivations, and openness to new opportunities
  • Present opportunities in a clear, compelling way that resonates with passive candidates
  • Accurately document candidate details including compensation expectations, timing, and potential barriers

Pipeline Management and Execution

  • Build and maintain a pipeline primarily driven by passive candidate outreach , not just inbound applicants
  • Manage multiple active searches simultaneously while maintaining organization and momentum
  • Ensure candidates are consistently moving through the process without delays
  • Prepare candidates for client interviews, including expectations, positioning, and feedback
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Crelate and related systems

Client and Team Collaboration

  • Partner with leadership to align on candidate profiles and search priorities
  • Communicate candidate updates, challenges, and market feedback in a timely manner
  • Work closely with the operations and research team to ensure strong execution across all searches
  • Contribute to team discussions around search strategy, candidate quality, and market trends

Performance Expectations

  • Maintain consistent daily call volume with a strong emphasis on outbound phone activity
  • Demonstrate the ability to engage and convert passive candidates into active conversations
  • Build a steady pipeline of qualified candidates sourced through outbound efforts
  • Deliver a consistent number of qualified candidate presentations per week
  • Maintain strong follow-up and response times with candidates and internal team members

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills suitable for professional U.S. business communication
  • Understanding of American business culture, communication style, and professional expectations
  • Comfort with high-volume outreach and phone-based recruiting
  • Ability to build rapport quickly and maintain relationships with candidates
  • Strong organization and time management skills
  • Competitive, driven mindset with a desire to be successful
  • Positive attitude and ability to keep pace with a fast-moving, high-performing team
  • Strong technical proficiency and comfort learning new tools and systems
  • Professional home office setup suitable for business calls
  • Reliable high-speed internet and availability during U.S. business hours (Central Time)

What Separates Top Recruiters

  • You are comfortable calling candidates who are not actively looking and earning their interest
  • You default to picking up the phone instead of relying solely on messages or applications
  • You know how to turn a cold call into a meaningful career conversation
  • You actively invest time in learning the industry, terminology, and roles you recruit for
  • You generate your own pipeline rather than relying on inbound flow
  • You maintain persistence and follow-through without being transactional

Ideal Background

  • Experience in recruiting, sales, or other high-activity, performance-driven roles
  • Experience with outbound calling, business development, or candidate sourcing
  • Familiarity with healthcare or executive recruiting is a plus, but not required
  • Track record of meeting or exceeding performance expectations

Compensation and Logistics

  • Competitive monthly salary plus performance-based commission
  • Full-time remote position
  • Central Time schedule
  • Performance-based growth opportunities

title: Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Nós, da Knewin , somos líderes na América Latina quando se trata de ajudar empresas e marcas a gerenciar sua reputação e presença online através de análises de dados. Com mais de 2.000 clientes, nosso objetivo é conectar nossos parceiros com seu público-alvo, visando conquistar sua preferência e alcançar resultados excepcionais para seus negócios. Valorizamos uma cultura que prioriza a agilidade, a flexibilidade e a satisfação do cliente, enquanto acreditamos no potencial transformador da tecnologia, do conhecimento e, principalmente, das pessoas.


Estamos buscando uma Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR para compor o time de Pessoas da Knewin. Nessa posição, você será responsável por garantir que nossa estrutura de remuneração seja competitiva, justa e sustentável — ao mesmo tempo em que transforma dados de RH em inteligência estratégica para o negócio. É uma vaga para quem une rigor analítico com visão de processos, e que se interessa genuinamente por automação e pelo uso prático de IA no dia a dia de RH.


Se você gosta de trabalhar com dados, entende de remuneração e quer atuar em um ambiente onde tecnologia e pessoas caminham juntas, essa posição é para você!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estrutura de Cargos e Salários: Administrar e manter a estrutura de cargos e salários da organização, garantindo a atualização contínua de tabelas, faixas, políticas e critérios de movimentação interna;
  • Análises e Movimentações Salariais: Conduzir análises salariais para subsidiar decisões de promoções, enquadramentos e ajustes, propondo alternativas alinhadas às diretrizes de remuneração e ao orçamento da companhia;
  • Ciclos de Mérito e Calibração: Conduzir os ciclos anuais de mérito, promoções e calibração salarial, garantindo consistência, equidade e aderência às políticas internas;
  • Pesquisas Salariais e Inteligência de Mercado: Conduzir pesquisas de mercado e estudos comparativos, identificando oportunidades para melhorar a competitividade da remuneração e embasando propostas de revisão de política;
  • Descrições de Cargo: Manter e evoluir as descrições de cargo da organização, apoiando lideranças na definição clara de responsabilidades, requisitos e escopo das posições;
  • Remuneração Variável e Programas de Incentivo: Apoiar no desenho e revisão de políticas de Remuneração Variável (ICP, bônus, comissões) e programas de incentivo, contribuindo para a efetividade dos mecanismos de reconhecimento;
  • People Analytics e Dashboards: Desenvolver e manter indicadores de RH, estruturar bases de dados e construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos que transformem dados em insumos relevantes para a tomada de decisão;
  • Automação e IA aplicada ao RH: Apoiar na identificação, desenvolvimento e implementação de automações e soluções com Inteligência Artificial voltadas aos processos de RH, contribuindo para a evolução e escala da área;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Propor melhorias contínuas em práticas, políticas e processos de remuneração e gestão de dados, com visão sistêmica e foco em resultados.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Psicologia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada em Remuneração, Estrutura de Cargos e Salários e análises organizacionais;
  • Domínio avançado de Excel e/ou Google Sheets;
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e indicadores em ferramentas de BI (Looker Studio ou similares);
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados, identificar tendências e gerar insights para suporte à decisão.


Também é legal se você tiver:


  • Vivência com People Analytics e governança de dados de RH;
  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia ou ambientes de startup;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de automação e aplicações práticas de Inteligência Artificial;
  • Experiência em modelos de trabalho remoto ou híbrido.

title: Technical Business Analyst – FIX Protocol / Trading Applications
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Business Analyst – FIX Protocol / Trading Applications em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Technical Business Analyst – FIX Protocol / Trading Applications

We are looking for a Technical Business Analyst with strong experience in FIX Protocol and trading applications to support technology initiatives within a global financial services environment.

This role requires a professional who can work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, application development teams and vendors to gather, analyze, document and validate business and technical requirements for trading-related systems.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with SQL queries, UNIX log analysis, functional specifications, data flows, system integrations and UAT support .

Key responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze and document business, functional and technical requirements for trading applications.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders, developers, vendors and product teams to define and validate technology solutions.
  • Create and maintain functional specifications, business rules, exception rules and process documentation.
  • Analyze system data across multiple platforms, including UNIX, FIX, Oracle, SQL Server and mainframe environments .
  • Perform SQL queries and UNIX log analysis to support requirements definition, issue investigation and validation.
  • Translate business needs into clear technical requirements for development teams.
  • Support data sourcing activities, validating data completeness from acquisition through report or system delivery.
  • Define and support testing requirements, test cases and UAT activities.
  • Conduct functional walkthroughs and obtain business sign-off.
  • Track project risks, defects, change requests and delivery status.
  • Support multiple projects or workstreams in parallel within the software development lifecycle.

Required experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or Technical Business Analyst .
  • Strong experience with FIX Protocol .
  • Experience working with trading applications or capital markets platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL queries .
  • Experience with UNIX log analysis .
  • Ability to write clear functional and technical requirements.
  • Experience creating FSDs , business requirements, test cases and UAT documentation.
  • Good understanding of system integrations, data flows and application troubleshooting.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders and business requirements to technical teams.
  • Experience working with developers, vendors, product managers and business SMEs.
  • Advanced English for communication with global teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience in financial services, brokerage, investment banking, wealth management or capital markets.
  • Knowledge of Oracle, SQL Server or mainframe environments.
  • Experience with data governance standards.
  • Experience leading small projects or coordinating workstreams.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models.

Ideal profile

The ideal candidate is not a purely functional BA. We are looking for a hands-on Technical Business Analyst who understands trading systems, can analyze FIX messages, read UNIX logs, write SQL queries, document requirements clearly and work directly with both business and technology teams.

title: Database Reliability Engineer - DBRE
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Database Reliability Engineer - DBRE em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Estamos em busca de um(a) DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer) para atuar em um ambiente orientado por Data Mesh , com foco em resiliência, automação e governança de dados distribuídos . Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade dos bancos de dados utilizados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia.


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e implementar estratégias de confiabilidade para bancos de dados em domínios distribuídos.
  • Automatizar processos de provisionamento, backup, monitoramento e recuperação de bancos de dados.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os times de produto e engenharia para garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance.
  • Atuar na observabilidade e rastreabilidade dos dados em ambientes SQL e NoSQL.
  • Participar da definição de padrões e políticas de governança de dados dentro da arquitetura Data Mesh.
  • Realizar troubleshooting e tuning de queries e estruturas de dados.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar recursos de banco de dados em AWS , utilizando serviços como RDS, Aurora, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, IAM e Secrets Manager .


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência avançada com SQL Server , PostgreSQL e MongoDB .
  • Domínio de AWS , especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) com Terraform ou CloudFormation .
  • Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python .
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD) e Data Mesh .
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD e integração com pipelines de dados.
  • Experiência com ambientes cloud-native e containers (Docker, Kubernetes) .


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Database Reliability Engineer - DBRE
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Database Reliability Engineer - DBRE em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Estamos em busca de um(a) DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer) para atuar em um ambiente orientado por Data Mesh , com foco em resiliência, automação e governança de dados distribuídos . Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade dos bancos de dados utilizados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia.


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e implementar estratégias de confiabilidade para bancos de dados em domínios distribuídos.
  • Automatizar processos de provisionamento, backup, monitoramento e recuperação de bancos de dados.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os times de produto e engenharia para garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance.
  • Atuar na observabilidade e rastreabilidade dos dados em ambientes SQL e NoSQL.
  • Participar da definição de padrões e políticas de governança de dados dentro da arquitetura Data Mesh.
  • Realizar troubleshooting e tuning de queries e estruturas de dados.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar recursos de banco de dados em AWS , utilizando serviços como RDS, Aurora, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, IAM e Secrets Manager .


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência avançada com SQL Server , PostgreSQL e MongoDB .
  • Domínio de AWS , especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) com Terraform ou CloudFormation .
  • Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python .
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD) e Data Mesh .
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD e integração com pipelines de dados.
  • Experiência com ambientes cloud-native e containers (Docker, Kubernetes) .


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Administrative Assistant em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Instead of applying to one remote job, you could access a community where new remote opportunities become available every week.


At Virtual Latinos, we connect experienced professionals from Latin America with growing companies in the U.S., Canada, and beyond that are building distributed remote teams. Our community includes more than 5,000+ professionals hired and 2,500+ companies that rely on Virtual Latinos to find skilled remote talent.


Join a community where you'll learn, connect with like-minded professionals, and access real remote opportunities with top North American companies.

Highlight Role of the Week!



Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-time Monthly Rates: $800 to $1,280 (20 hours per week)


Full-time Monthly Rates: $1,600 to $2,560 (40 hours per week)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated based on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16, depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position you apply for, as it will be based on the client's requested schedule. All our clients are in the U.S., and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, coordinating schedules, maintaining communication with internal and external teams, and managing tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to the job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Mindhive Global is a New Zealand based, AI-driven technology company, operating at global scale. Using advanced machine vision and bespoke AI models, the company enables tanneries to grade hides accurately from wet-blue to finished leather and identify defects with greater accuracy and consistency than manual inspection. This verified quality data supports stronger supplier negotiations, improves traceability, and informs strategic decisions. By optimising order fulfillment and quality control, Mindhive Global helps customers increase efficiency, reduce waste, and build more resilient supply chains.


The Role

This is not a SaaS helpdesk role! It is TAM flavoured role, not a pure relationship role.


You will own the day-to-day success of a small portfolio of large, multi-year contracted enterprise accounts - each operating across multiple sites in multiple countries. You'll work across the full stack: hardware-enabled software deployments in industrial environments, platform adoption, data analysis, executive QBRs, and commercial expansion. You'll be the person who makes Mindhive's verified hide data deliver measurable business value for customers — and who documents and proves that it does.


In practice, that means:

  • Owning the full customer relationship across every stakeholder layer — from site operators on the production floor to executive sponsors in the boardroom — and building multi-threaded coverage so no account is ever dependent on a single contact
  • Driving onboarding and implementation as the primary customer contact, working alongside Field Operations through installation and onboarding, with a target of time-to-value under six months
  • Analysing operational and customer data site by site, translating findings into clear insights for both customer and internal audiences — and always validating findings against the customer's operational reality before presenting them
  • Running Quarterly Business Reviews with executive sponsors, owning the value realisation narrative, and documenting ROI in a form customers can take directly into their own internal reporting
  • Maintaining a five-dimension customer health dashboard — Relationship, Business Value, Operational Delivery, Adoption, and Commercial Momentum — and flagging risks before they escalate
  • Surfacing expansion opportunities — additional sites, new product lines, geographic rollouts — and handing them to Commercial with enough context to act
  • Supporting renewal preparation 12–18 months in advance, with a documented value summary and business case


You'll report directly to the Chief Customer Officer (who is based in Auckland New Zealand), and work alongside Commercial, Field Operations, and Product.


What this role requires

  • Fluent English: written and spoken; all customer and internal work is conducted in English;

(additional languages preferred, especially Portuguese)

  • Demonstrated experience managing more than three enterprise customers simultaneously , across multiple countries. If your experience is domestic or single-account, this role is not the right fit
  • Experience with large, strategic accounts on multi-year contracts: you understand how enterprise relationships are built and protected over time
  • Technical fluency in hardware-enabled software environments: you can engage credibly with IT and operations teams, understand system integrations, and interpret operational data without needing a translator
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% internationally (Brazil, Argentina, UK, Germany, and expanding)
  • Ability to work as a full-time independent contractor, invoicing a New Zealand company


What will make you stand out

  • Background in sectors where technology is deployed into physical operational environments: manufacturing, food processing, mining, logistics, utilities, or similar
  • Experience with hardware + software deployments (definitely NOT pure SaaS)
  • Data analytics capability: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent
  • Active, daily use of AI tools to improve your own output and analysis quality
  • Familiarity with formal customer success frameworks and methodologies


What you'll be measured on

Relationship health, documented ROI delivered for each account, platform adoption rates, onboarding time-to-value, and commercial expansion. You'll own the full customer health picture — not just satisfaction scores.


Compensation

Competitive, commensurate with experience. Paid in USD as a contractor engagement.

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Salary - 120,898 BRL Annually

Fully Remote

Start Date - ASAP, need immediate joiners


Must Haves:

Enterprise PM experience: 2–4+ years managing large, high-risk IT projects (data, infrastructure, or application development) in global environments

Strong, assertive PM leadership: Proactive “activist” PM who can drive projects forward, make tough decisions, and push back when needed

Proven experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe preferred), with flexibility to work across Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid environments

Full lifecycle ownership: Ability to manage scope, timelines, budgets, and cross-functional teams across multiple concurrent projects (often 3–4 at a time)

Strong communication & stakeholder management: Confident interacting across all levels, building relationships, driving accountability, and facilitating Agile ceremonies

Bilingual (English, Spanish, Portugues)

Financial background

Nice to Haves:

Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe Scrum Master, CSM/PSM, or other Agile certifications

Tools & platforms: Experience with Jira, ServiceNow, PowerBI, and collaboration tools like Miro/whiteboarding tools

Technical breadth: Exposure to both cloud and on-prem IT initiatives

Change management experience: Background in organizational change, adoption strategies, or transformation initiatives

Day to Day:

A client of Insight Global is seeking a Project Manager to join their team remotely. This individual will manage 3–4 concurrent enterprise IT projects across data, infrastructure, and application development. Day-to-day, they will drive delivery across Agile/Scrum, SAFe, and hybrid teams, lead standups and stakeholder updates, track budgets and timelines, and ensure scope alignment. They will proactively mitigate risks, enforce accountability, and communicate effectively across global teams in English and Spanish/Portuguese.

title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that helps companies scale their teams on demand.


A Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert is needed to design, build, launch, and optimize email, messaging, segmentation, and automation solutions. This role will support critical marketing technology initiatives, guide junior developers, and act as a module lead or point of contact for one or more markets or countries.


The role involves working across email development, journey orchestration, audience segmentation, reporting, and platform process improvements.

The expert will work with geographically distributed teams, including developers, project managers, and market stakeholders. Key objectives include improving campaign execution, maintaining reliable system processes, supporting new proof-of-concept initiatives, and identifying trends or issues that can inform future marketing decisions.


Task and deliverables:

  • Build, launch, and monitor email campaigns, messages, journeys, and audience segmentation within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Implement and support the full lifecycle of email and messaging initiatives, from development through testing, deployment, reporting, and optimization.
  • Develop reusable email templates, content assets, and campaign components using HTML, CSS, AMPscript, SSJS, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud tools.
  • Create and maintain audience segments, automations, and data-driven campaign logic using SQL and relevant SFMC modules.
  • Generate, review, and interpret email performance reports to identify trends, issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support campaign asset development, including selecting or adapting imagery and content elements that improve audience response.
  • Guide junior developers on Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities, standards, and best practices.
  • Act as module lead and point of contact for one or more markets or countries.
  • Document system processes, recurring issues, campaign workflows, and technical recommendations for the project team.
  • Develop and support proof-of-concept initiatives for new Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions and enhancements.


Required experience:

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Required: 6–7+ years of IT experience, including 3–4+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience.
  • Required: Strong knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and core email marketing, messaging, segmentation, and automation concepts.
  • Required: Experience with at least three Salesforce Marketing Cloud modules, such as Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Contact Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Advertising Studio, SQL, or audience creation.
  • Required: Experience writing moderately complex SQL queries for segmentation, reporting, or automation use cases.
  • Required: Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, AMPscript, and SSJS for email and campaign development.
  • Required: Strong attention to detail and experience with email testing, quality assurance, and deployment validation.
  • Required: Understanding of Salesforce best practices for marketing automation, data management, campaign execution, and platform governance.
  • Required: Ability to work independently with a high degree of ownership in a geographically distributed team.
  • Required: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience acting as a module lead, market lead, country point of contact, or technical owner for Salesforce Marketing Cloud workstreams.
  • Nice to have: Experience supporting proofs of concept or implementing new marketing technology solutions.


Engagement highlights:

  • Opportunity to lead Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities across one or more markets or countries.
  • Hands-on role covering campaign development, automation, reporting, optimization, and new solution design.
  • Collaborative environment with distributed development, project management, and business stakeholder teams.

title: Staffing Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staffing Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.


About the Role


We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.



What You'll Do


  • Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs.
  • Support the end-to-end matching process by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions.
  • Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities.
  • Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers.
  • Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving.
  • Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties.
  • Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.


What We’re Looking For


  • At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role.
  • Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment.
  • Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric.
  • High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change.
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach.
  • Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.


Why You Should Join


  • Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :)
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that helps companies scale their teams on demand.


A Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert is needed to design, build, launch, and optimize email, messaging, segmentation, and automation solutions. This role will support critical marketing technology initiatives, guide junior developers, and act as a module lead or point of contact for one or more markets or countries.


The role involves working across email development, journey orchestration, audience segmentation, reporting, and platform process improvements.

The expert will work with geographically distributed teams, including developers, project managers, and market stakeholders. Key objectives include improving campaign execution, maintaining reliable system processes, supporting new proof-of-concept initiatives, and identifying trends or issues that can inform future marketing decisions.


Task and deliverables:

  • Build, launch, and monitor email campaigns, messages, journeys, and audience segmentation within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Implement and support the full lifecycle of email and messaging initiatives, from development through testing, deployment, reporting, and optimization.
  • Develop reusable email templates, content assets, and campaign components using HTML, CSS, AMPscript, SSJS, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud tools.
  • Create and maintain audience segments, automations, and data-driven campaign logic using SQL and relevant SFMC modules.
  • Generate, review, and interpret email performance reports to identify trends, issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support campaign asset development, including selecting or adapting imagery and content elements that improve audience response.
  • Guide junior developers on Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities, standards, and best practices.
  • Act as module lead and point of contact for one or more markets or countries.
  • Document system processes, recurring issues, campaign workflows, and technical recommendations for the project team.
  • Develop and support proof-of-concept initiatives for new Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions and enhancements.


Required experience:

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Required: 6–7+ years of IT experience, including 3–4+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience.
  • Required: Strong knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and core email marketing, messaging, segmentation, and automation concepts.
  • Required: Experience with at least three Salesforce Marketing Cloud modules, such as Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Contact Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Advertising Studio, SQL, or audience creation.
  • Required: Experience writing moderately complex SQL queries for segmentation, reporting, or automation use cases.
  • Required: Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, AMPscript, and SSJS for email and campaign development.
  • Required: Strong attention to detail and experience with email testing, quality assurance, and deployment validation.
  • Required: Understanding of Salesforce best practices for marketing automation, data management, campaign execution, and platform governance.
  • Required: Ability to work independently with a high degree of ownership in a geographically distributed team.
  • Required: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience acting as a module lead, market lead, country point of contact, or technical owner for Salesforce Marketing Cloud workstreams.
  • Nice to have: Experience supporting proofs of concept or implementing new marketing technology solutions.


Engagement highlights:

  • Opportunity to lead Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities across one or more markets or countries.
  • Hands-on role covering campaign development, automation, reporting, optimization, and new solution design.
  • Collaborative environment with distributed development, project management, and business stakeholder teams.

title: Fonoaudiólogo
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fonoaudiólogo em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fonoaudiólogo(a) | Saúde Auditiva e Reabilitação Auditiva

Salvador/BA | Presencial | CLT


Mais do que reabilitar, nós devolvemos conexões. ✨


Na Sonora Centro Auditivo, acreditamos que ouvir bem é viver melhor.

Todos os dias ajudamos pessoas a voltarem a participar das conversas em família, recuperarem sua autonomia e reconquistarem a confiança para se comunicar.

Se você é Fonoaudiólogo(a), tem paixão por cuidar de pessoas e deseja atuar em uma empresa referência em saúde auditiva, queremos conhecer você.


Sobre a Sonora

Com 29 anos de experiência, a Sonora Centro Auditivo é referência em saúde auditiva na Bahia, oferecendo atendimento humanizado, tecnologia de ponta e acompanhamento contínuo aos pacientes.

Nossa missão é transformar vidas por meio da audição, devolvendo às pessoas a conexão com quem amam e mais qualidade de vida.


O que você fará

  • Realizar avaliações e atendimentos em saúde auditiva;
  • Interpretar exames audiológicos;
  • Indicar, selecionar e adaptar aparelhos auditivos;
  • Acompanhar pacientes durante o processo de adaptação;
  • Realizar ajustes e orientações de uso dos aparelhos;
  • Desenvolver relacionamento próximo e humanizado com pacientes e familiares;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva na recomendação das melhores soluções auditivas para cada caso;
  • Contribuir para o alcance das metas da unidade através de um atendimento de excelência.

title: Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst para atuar na estruturação, evolução e governança do framework de indicadores de performance de serviços de Tecnologia da Informação, em ambiente corporativo de grande porte.

Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a consistência, padronização e confiabilidade dos indicadores utilizados na gestão de performance de serviços de TI, atuando de forma estratégica na definição e evolução de métricas que suportem a tomada de decisão e a excelência operacional.

O papel exige forte interação com áreas técnicas, operações de TI, times de dados/BI e stakeholders de negócio, traduzindo demandas operacionais e estratégicas em indicadores mensuráveis, acionáveis e alinhados aos objetivos organizacionais.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estruturar, evoluir e governar o framework de indicadores de performance de serviços de TI;
  • Garantir padronização metodológica, clareza conceitual e rastreabilidade dos indicadores;
  • Definir conceitos, fórmulas, regras de cálculo e critérios de análise de KPIs;
  • Identificar e priorizar lacunas de mensuração nos pilares de custo, prazo, qualidade e nível de serviço (SLAs/SLOs);
  • Conduzir ciclos de validação de indicadores junto às áreas técnicas e stakeholders;
  • Atuar na gestão e priorização do backlog de indicadores, considerando impacto e viabilidade;
  • Apoiar a construção e evolução de frameworks de governança de performance em TI;
  • Monitorar a maturidade dos indicadores e propor melhorias contínuas;
  • Atuar em conjunto com times de BI e dados para implementação e operacionalização das métricas;
  • Traduzir demandas estratégicas e operacionais em indicadores acionáveis;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, apoiando lideranças na tomada de decisão orientada por dados.


Requisitos e qualificações:

Obrigatórios

  • Formação superior ou pós-graduação em Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Vivência na definição, estruturação e governança de KPIs e indicadores de performance;
  • Experiência em ambientes de TI, com interface entre áreas técnicas, operações e dados;
  • Capacidade de atuação tanto em nível estratégico quanto no detalhamento conceitual de indicadores;
  • Experiência com stakeholders e suporte à tomada de decisão baseada em dados.


Desejáveis

  • Experiência em ambientes de Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC) ou operações de serviços de TI;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, etc.);
  • Experiência em Data & Analytics;
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de gestão de serviços (ITIL) e governança (COBIT);
  • Vivência com metodologias de melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma);
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos ou de grande porte.


Diferenciais do perfil

  • Experiência prévia na estruturação de indicadores corporativos de TI;
  • Atuação em governança de métricas de performance e eficiência operacional;
  • Capacidade de conectar dados técnicos com impacto de negócio;
  • Perfil analítico, estruturado e orientado à melhoria contínua.



Sobre a empresa

Compass UOL is a global firm and part of the AI Revolution Company, together transforming organizations using Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and other of today’s most advanced techno

logies.We equip our team with proprietary and external AI-driven tools to design and build digital-native platforms, integrating cutting-edge technologies and enabling companies to innovate, transform their businesses, and drive success in their m

arkets.To achieve this, we attract and develop the best talent, creating opportunities that enhance people’s lives and highlight the positive impact of disruptive techno

logies.We empower borderless talent and promote knowledge and opportunities in the latest market trends, driving significant personal and professional


growth.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de inglês em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto!

Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade.

Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis.


Sobre nós:  Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades.


Visão geral da posição

  • Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos.
  • Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula.
  • Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos.
  • Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas.
  • Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas.
  • Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no.


Formato

  • Contratação: Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI)
  • Local : Remoto
  • Carga Horária: Você define a sua própria agenda


Requisitos

  • Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1)
  • Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula.
  • Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo).
  • Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online.
  • CNPJ / MEI ativo.


Por que se juntar à nós?

  • Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem.
  • Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino.
  • Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto!

Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade.

title: Declaration Drafter - Immigration
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Declaration Drafter - Immigration em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who Are We?


Bueno Law is a trailblazing immigration law firm focused on empowering the Latin American LGBTQ+ community, survivors of domestic violence, victims of human trafficking, and other vulnerable individuals. We provide life-changing legal services to immigrants in the United States, and we’re looking for passionate, people-first individuals to join our remote team.


We specialize in:


  • Removal Defense (EOIR).
  • Asylum & Humanitarian Relief (U/T visas, VAWA, SIJS).
  • Family‑Based Immigration.

Your Role as a Declaration Drafter


We are looking for an immigration declaration drafter to join our team of Warriors. We do not require experience; we offer a full training program. The ideal candidate is 100% fluent in English and Portuguese, has excellent writing and communication skills, is detail-oriented and a self-starter. Experience in the Psychological or Social Services field. Must be able to work well with different cultures and languages. We require a positive attitude and someone who strives for finding solutions instead of obstacles. We would like the new Warrior to be able to commit full-time to this position (9am-6pm PST).


Who we are looking for:


  • Experience in providing psychological or social services
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Portuguese
  • Ability to Multi-Task
  • Strong Analytical Skills
  • Decision-Making ability
  • Strong Research Skills
  • Team Player
  • Excellent Customer Service Skills
  • Highly organized individual
  • Fast learner
  • Honest
  • Excellent time management skills
  • Must match our growth and improvement mindset and help implement efficiency techniques
  • Reliable and dependable
  • Hardworking 


Essential Duties And Responsibilities:


  • Schedule appointments and maintain calendars.
  • Write and edit documents from letters to reports and instructional documents.
  • Create and maintain filing systems, both electronic and physical.
  • Handle daily client communications.
  • Maintains filing systems as assigned.
  • Retrieves information as requested from records, email, minutes, and other related documents; prepares written summaries of data when needed.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.


What We Offer:


  • Competitive pay above market rate.
  • Paid vacation + sick leave.
  • Your birthday off.
  • U.S. paid holidays.
  • Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM PST.
  • A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.


How to Apply:


Send your resume to with the position in the subject line.

Applications submitted through LinkedIn will not be reviewed.

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Support Representative, Level 1 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis.


Responsibilities:


  • Manage large amounts of incoming tickets.
  • Provide support to answer inquiries on products.
  • Accept and handle technical requests.
  • Triage tickets to the other teams.
  • Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies.
  • Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools.
  • Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication.
  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution.
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents.
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers.
  • Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.


Skills And Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s degree completed
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience in customer support roles
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion.
  • Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics.
  • Attention to detail is key to this position.
  • Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs.
  • Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills.
  • Proficient with ticketing tools ( Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce).


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: English Teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English Teacher em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Overview


Most English schools in Brazil sell the same thing: promises. Promises of fluency. Promises of confidence. Promises of transformation. And most of them fail to deliver. Not because their teachers aren't capable, but because their model was never built around results in the first place.


AM Consultoria de Inglês was built differently.


We work exclusively with adult learners, using a communicative approach that prioritises real speaking ability. We measure what actually matters: whether our students can use English to do something meaningful with their lives. Every class, every follow-up, every piece of feedback we give is designed with that outcome in mind.


We're growing. And we're looking for a teacher who wants to be part of something that takes results seriously.


If you want a place to clock in, teach, and clock out, this isn't it. If you want to build something that genuinely changes people's lives, read on.



Position Details


  • Role: English Language Coach
  • Location: 100% Remote
  • Employment Type: Contract
  • Start Date: Immediate


Candidates MUST be available Monday through Thursday, 7–9pm. Weekly team meeting: Mondays at 10am (30 minutes).



What You'll Do


  • Plan and deliver engaging, communicative classes that students actually remember
  • Support students via WhatsApp between sessions. We stay close to our learners
  • Proactively check in with students to understand their needs and keep them on track
  • Pursue your own professional development. We expect it and we support it



Technical Requirements


  • High-quality video and audio setup
  • Fast, stable internet connection



What We Require


  • CELTA, DELTA, or TKT certification (Cambridge)
  • C2 English proficiency
  • Strong command of Communicative Language Teaching methodology
  • Confident use of online teaching platforms and digital tools



What We're Looking For


Beyond qualifications, we're looking for someone who:


  • Brings genuine energy to every class, Not performance, real presence
  • Is ambitious and wants to grow, with potential to take on leadership responsibility
  • Receives feedback well and actively uses it to improve
  • Communicates proactively and takes ownership of their students' progress
  • Is humble enough to keep learning, no matter their level of experience
  • Has lived, worked, or studied in an English-speaking environment (a strong advantage)



Why AM Consultoria


  • Above-average compensation compared to the broader ESL market in Brazil
  • A methodology that actually works, and that you'll be proud to deliver
  • Adult learners who are motivated, goal-driven, and serious about progress
  • Real input into how we develop and improve our product
  • A small, high-performance team that holds each other to a high standard
  • Room to grow into more than a teacher



We'll be sharing more about our vision, mission, and approach via the link below. If what you've read here resonates — we'd like to hear from you.


Apply now.

A Jusfy está em busca de uma pessoa Analista Pleno de Parcerias Institucionais. Somos uma legaltech em crescimento acelerado - desenvolvemos tecnologia, IA e ferramentas de produtividade para advogados e departamentos jurídicos do Brasil.

O que você vai fazer:

Competitive Base Salary + Performance Bonus

Top performers will have significant earning potential tied to their impact on company profitability.
