title: Head of Compliance, Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Compliance, Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Head of Compliance & MLRO to oversee the company's compliance and regulatory responsibilities in Brazil. This role will support the business in maintaining a strong compliance culture, managing regulatory relationships, and ensuring alignment with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.


Working closely with local and regional stakeholders, the successful candidate will provide practical compliance guidance while supporting the company's growth and licensing initiatives in Brazil.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated MLRO and lead compliance representative for the Brazil business.
  • Oversee the company's compliance, AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial crime programs.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations.
  • Support licensing, registration, and other regulatory initiatives as required.
  • Provide compliance advice to business and operational teams on new products, services, and business activities.
  • Help ensure policies, procedures, and controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations.
  • Oversee key compliance processes, including customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions.
  • Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management.
  • Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization.
  • Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets.
  • Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred.
  • Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous.
  • Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial.
  • Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment.
  • Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.


OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis.


Responsibilities:


  • Manage large amounts of incoming tickets.
  • Provide support to answer inquiries on products.
  • Accept and handle technical requests.
  • Triage tickets to the other teams.

  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution.
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents.
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers.
  • Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.


Skills And Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s degree completed
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience in customer support roles
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion.
  • Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics.
  • Attention to detail is key to this position.
  • Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs.
  • Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills.
  • Proficient with ticketing tools ( Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce).


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Business Development & Strategic Partnerships Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Development & Strategic Partnerships Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly connected, results-oriented Business Development & Strategic Partnerships Manager to accelerate global growth through strategic alliances, influencer ecosystems, community partnerships, and market expansion initiatives.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven relationship-builder with an established network across emerging and high-growth markets, including Latin America (LATAM), the Middle East, Turkey, Africa, South Asia, Southeast Asia, East Asia, and the CIS region. Priority markets include India, Pakistan, Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, the Philippines, Taiwan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, and Azerbaijan.

The successful candidate will leverage existing industry relationships, cultivate new strategic opportunities, and build scalable partnerships that drive user acquisition, brand awareness, engagement, and long-term business growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify, develop, negotiate, and execute strategic partnerships with influencers, creators, agencies, brands, media organizations, sports communities, entrepreneurs, investors, and industry leaders.
  • Drive user acquisition and market expansion through partnership-led growth initiatives and regional ecosystem development.
  • Build and manage a high-performing network of ambassadors, affiliates, referral partners, and strategic collaborators.
  • Establish partnerships with sports personalities, creator networks, digital publishers, online communities, and relevant industry organizations.
  • Source and close high-impact commercial opportunities that generate measurable business results.
  • Represent the company at industry conferences, networking events, trade shows, and executive-level meetings.
  • Collaborate with leadership to identify new markets, growth channels, and strategic opportunities.
  • Maintain a robust partnership pipeline, track performance metrics, and consistently achieve growth targets.
  • Provide market intelligence and competitive insights to support expansion and business strategy.


Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, growth, enterprise sales, ecosystem development, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage professional networks to create strategic business opportunities and measurable growth outcomes.
  • Established relationships with influencers, creators, agencies, media organizations, entrepreneurs, investors, sports organizations, technology communities, or digital platforms.
  • Experience working with talent agencies, marketing agencies, PR firms, affiliate networks, creator ecosystems, or large online communities.
  • Proven track record of driving user acquisition, engagement, revenue growth, or market expansion through partnerships.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Highly entrepreneurial, self-motivated, and comfortable operating in fast-paced, growth-oriented environments.
  • Ability to work independently while building trust-based relationships across diverse international markets.


Preferred Performance Indicators

  • Strategic partnerships executed
  • Users acquired through partnerships
  • Market expansion initiatives launched
  • Affiliate and ambassador network growth
  • Revenue or engagement generated through partnerships
  • Partnership retention and activation rates

Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.

A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.

  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:


  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.


Modo de contratação:


  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital

title: Arquiteto de soluções - IA Microsoft
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto de soluções - IA Microsoft em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Arquiteto de soluções - IA & Intelligent Applications


Estamos buscando um(a) profissional com foco em IA aplicada no Azure. Você vai atuar diretamente com clientes, liderando engajamentos técnicos de ponta a ponta: desde o design de arquitetura até a implantação em produção de soluções inteligentes com Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio e ecossistema Microsoft AI. O foco é remover bloqueios técnicos, acelerar adoção e garantir que as soluções de IA saiam do PoC para escala real.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência com Fundamentos de IA e LLMs: Entendimento sólido de como LLMs funcionam, como o tokens, contexto, temperatura, hallucination e grounding. - Experiência prática com prompt engineering: system prompts, few-shot, chain-of-thought e instrução estruturada. -Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura de IA: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), agentes com tool use e orquestração de múltiplos agentes. - Familiaridade com avaliação de qualidade de modelos: métricas como relevância, fundamentação e coerência.
  • Experiência com Azure AI Foundry: Criação de projetos, deploy de modelos e configuração de endpoints. - Uso do model catalog, fine-tuning e avaliação de modelos dentro do Foundry. - Configuração de grounding com Azure AI Search (indexação, chunking, estratégias de retrieval). - Integração com Azure OpenAI Service e outros modelos disponíveis no Foundry.
  • Experiência com Copilot Studio: Experiência com criação de agentes no Copilot Studio na criação de tópicos, entidades, variáveis e fluxo conversacional. - Integração de agentes com fontes de conhecimento externas (SharePoint, sites, documentos). - Configuração de actions e conexão com Power Automate para automações a partir do agente. - Publicação e deployment de agentes em canais (Teams, web, outros)
  • Experiência com Arquitetura e Cloud: Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas orientadas a IA no Azure (AI Foundry + Search + Storage + Function/App Service). - Entendimento de segurança aplicada a IA: managed identity, RBAC, data residency, responsible AI. - Habilidade de comunicar arquiteturas técnicas para públicos técnicos e executivos.


Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions para CI/CD de soluções de IA (MLOps light);
  • Familiaridade com Python para prototipagem rápida, scripts de indexação ou integração com SDKs de IA;
  • Conhecimento de Azure Functions ou Logic Apps para automação serverless;
  • Experiência com Azure API Management (APIM) para expor e governar endpoints de IA;
  • Familiaridade com conectores customizados e extensões de agente (Copilot extensibility);
  • Conhecimento de Azure SQL, Cosmos DB ou PostgreSQL para persistência em soluções de IA;
  • Experiência com Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) ou containerização de modelos/aplicações;
  • Familiaridade com monitoramento de IA: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, logging de prompts/respostas;
  • Certificação AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate);
  • Certificação PL-100 / PL-200 (Power Platform);
  • Certificação AZ-204 (Azure Developer Associate);




Modelo de atuação: Home Office, mas precisa ter disponibilidade para viajar esporadicamente;

Contratação CLT


O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;



Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Arquiteto de soluções - IA Microsoft
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto de soluções - IA Microsoft em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Arquiteto de soluções - IA & Intelligent Applications


Estamos buscando um(a) profissional com foco em IA aplicada no Azure. Você vai atuar diretamente com clientes, liderando engajamentos técnicos de ponta a ponta: desde o design de arquitetura até a implantação em produção de soluções inteligentes com Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio e ecossistema Microsoft AI. O foco é remover bloqueios técnicos, acelerar adoção e garantir que as soluções de IA saiam do PoC para escala real.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência com Fundamentos de IA e LLMs: Entendimento sólido de como LLMs funcionam, como o tokens, contexto, temperatura, hallucination e grounding. - Experiência prática com prompt engineering: system prompts, few-shot, chain-of-thought e instrução estruturada. -Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura de IA: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), agentes com tool use e orquestração de múltiplos agentes. - Familiaridade com avaliação de qualidade de modelos: métricas como relevância, fundamentação e coerência.
  • Experiência com Azure AI Foundry: Criação de projetos, deploy de modelos e configuração de endpoints. - Uso do model catalog, fine-tuning e avaliação de modelos dentro do Foundry. - Configuração de grounding com Azure AI Search (indexação, chunking, estratégias de retrieval). - Integração com Azure OpenAI Service e outros modelos disponíveis no Foundry.
  • Experiência com Copilot Studio: Experiência com criação de agentes no Copilot Studio na criação de tópicos, entidades, variáveis e fluxo conversacional. - Integração de agentes com fontes de conhecimento externas (SharePoint, sites, documentos). - Configuração de actions e conexão com Power Automate para automações a partir do agente. - Publicação e deployment de agentes em canais (Teams, web, outros)
  • Experiência com Arquitetura e Cloud: Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas orientadas a IA no Azure (AI Foundry + Search + Storage + Function/App Service). - Entendimento de segurança aplicada a IA: managed identity, RBAC, data residency, responsible AI. - Habilidade de comunicar arquiteturas técnicas para públicos técnicos e executivos.


Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions para CI/CD de soluções de IA (MLOps light);
  • Familiaridade com Python para prototipagem rápida, scripts de indexação ou integração com SDKs de IA;
  • Conhecimento de Azure Functions ou Logic Apps para automação serverless;
  • Experiência com Azure API Management (APIM) para expor e governar endpoints de IA;
  • Familiaridade com conectores customizados e extensões de agente (Copilot extensibility);
  • Conhecimento de Azure SQL, Cosmos DB ou PostgreSQL para persistência em soluções de IA;
  • Experiência com Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) ou containerização de modelos/aplicações;
  • Familiaridade com monitoramento de IA: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, logging de prompts/respostas;
  • Certificação AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate);
  • Certificação PL-100 / PL-200 (Power Platform);
  • Certificação AZ-204 (Azure Developer Associate);




Modelo de atuação: Home Office, mas precisa ter disponibilidade para viajar esporadicamente;

Contratação CLT


O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;



Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Franqueado
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Franqueado em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição do Cargo Estamos procurando um Franqueado para integrar a equipe da BT AGRO BRASIL. Este cargo tem como principais responsabilidades a gestão e operação de uma franquia, incluindo o planejamento estratégico, controle financeiro e desenvolvimento de estratégias de vendas locais. O candidato também será responsável por estabelecer e manter relações sólidas com clientes e parceiros. Este é um cargo remoto e se dá em regime de contrato, oferecendo flexibilidade ao franqueado para gerenciar suas operações.


Remuneração:

  • Entre R$ 40.000,00 a R$ 100.000,00 mensal


*Valor pago por comissionamento de contratos fechados, resultado depende de performance.


Qualificações:

  • Gestão e Operação: Experiência em gerenciamento de negócios, controle de operações e planejamento estratégico.
  • Vendas e Relacionamento: Habilidade em vendas consultivas, negociação e construção de relacionamentos duradouros com clientes e parceiros.
  • Controle Financeiro: Conhecimentos em gerenciamento de orçamento, análise financeira e controle de custos para garantir a lucratividade da franquia.
  • Formação em Administração de Empresas, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas será um diferencial, assim como experiência prévia no setor agrícola ou de franquias.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma, com boa organização e habilidades de liderança serão altamente valorizadas.

title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:


O Grupo Capital:


Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.


Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:


A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.


Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:


  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.


Modo de contratação:


  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital


Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Consultor (a) SAP BW Hana - Remoto
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor (a) SAP BW Hana - Remoto em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


The SAP BW Lead will be responsible for leading end to end SAP BW initiatives, including architecture, design, development, migration, and operational support across SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA landscapes. The role will also own real time and near real time data replication using SAP SLT, ensure performant analytics leveraging Native HANA modeling, and act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.

This is a hands on leadership role requiring deep technical expertise as well as team and delivery ownership.


Key Responsibilities:


Advanced English


• Lead design and implementation of SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA solutions including modeling, data acquisition, transformations, and reporting layers.


• Define and govern BW architecture standards, object reuse strategy, naming conventions, transport strategy, and performance benchmarks.


• Own delivery across implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support engagements.

Data Acquisition & Integration (SLT Focus)


• Design and manage real time and delta data replication from SAP ECC / SAP S/4HANA to BW using SAP SLT.


• Ensure optimal data flow design covering ODP, SLT, and standard extractors, with reconciliation and monitoring frameworks.


• Work closely with Basis and source system teams to ensure stable and scalable replication setups.


SAP BW Modeling & Transformations:


o InfoObjects, ADSOs (Field based & InfoObject based)


o Composite Providers, Open ODS Views


o Transformations, DTPs, Process Chains


Design and optimize Native HANA objects, including:


o Calculation Views, Table Functions, SQL Script procedures

o CDS Views (where applicable)

• Leverage push down logic to HANA to improve query and load performance.


• Collaborate with BW and HANA teams to decide optimal BW vs Native HANA modeling strategy.


Reporting & Analytics:


Oversee reporting solutions using:


o BEx Queries / Analysis for Office / SAP BO / SAC (where applicable)


• Ensure reporting performance, semantic consistency, and business KPI alignment across domains (FI, CO, SD, MM, Supply Chain).


Migration & Modernization:


Lead BW on HANA / BW/4HANA conversion and migration programs, including:


o Readiness checks and simplification item handling


o Remediation of custom code and data models


o Data volume management and performance validation


• Support S/4HANA transformation programs from an analytics perspective.

Production Support & Governance

• Act as escalation point for production issues, SLA adherence, root cause analysis, and resolution.

• Ensure strong governance around transports (ChaRM), releases, incident/change management, and documentation.


Team & Stakeholder Leadership:


• Mentor and guide SAP BW developers and HANA modelers.

• Work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, architects, and program managers.

• Contribute to effort estimation, planning, and delivery commitments.

description:

About Turing

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Power Electronics PCB Design Expert to design, evaluate, and validate power electronic circuits and PCB layouts. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in power supply design, component selection, PCB layout best practices, and design verification methodologies.


Key Responsibilties

  • Design power electronic circuits including DC-DC converters, LDOs, AC-DC power supplies, and automotive power systems.
  • Create schematics and PCB layouts using tools such as KiCad, Altium, or equivalent.
  • Select components based on electrical, thermal, and reliability requirements.
  • Perform design analysis for efficiency, ripple, thermal performance, EMI, and manufacturability.
  • Generate manufacturing deliverables including BOMs, Gerber files, and assembly data.

  • Develop and apply verification frameworks for schematic and PCB layout quality, including specification compliance, topology validation, component derating, DFM, thermal integrity, and power integrity.


Required Skills

  • Strong understanding of power electronics fundamentals (DC-DC converters, switching regulators, LDOs, power components) .
  • Hands-on experience with schematic design and PCB layout.
  • Proficiency with PCB design tools (KiCad, Altium, or similar) .
  • Ability to interpret datasheets and validate component selection.
  • Knowledge of DRC, manufacturability, grounding, routing, and EMI best practices .


Preferred Skills

  • Experience with AC-DC power supply design and automotive electronics.
  • Familiarity with thermal analysis, power integrity, and simulation tools.
  • Experience developing hardware validation or evaluation frameworks.
  • Basic scripting experience (Python/terminal-based verification workflows).


Qualification

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in power electronics and PCB design .


Key Compentencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Attention to detail and design quality.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate across teams.
  • Effective communication skills.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Full Stack Developer to join our team. The candidate will have the mission of bringing his expertise and contribution in the rapid growth of one of our current star products. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining both the front-end and back-end of our web applications, while working in a very tight group of collaborators in a growth hacking mode, constantly integrating new cutting edge AI technologies in the context of a high volume traffic web application.


This role requires a strong understanding of the entire development process, including design, development, and deployment, and a commitment to collaborative problem solving, sophisticated design, and the creation of quality products.


What the ideal candidate will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Proven experience as a Full Stack Developer.
  • Availability to work with North American hours
  • Strong experience in building user interfaces and backend services using Typescript/React/Next.js.
  • Deep understanding of TypeScript, typing patterns, interfaces, generics, and strict type safety.
  • Experience building REST APIs and/or Route Handlers / Server Actions in Next.js.
  • Experience building React based frontend component with Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, or other styling systems.
  • Thorough understanding of PostgreSQL (schema design, indexing, query optimization).
  • Experience with third-party API integrations (webhooks, auth etc.).
  • Experience deploying Next.js apps on Vercel, AWS, or other cloud providers.
  • Familiarity with logging/monitoring tools (Sentry, Datadog, CloudWatch).
  • Understanding of version control systems, such as Git.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to a non-technical audience.
  • Self-motivated and able to work effectively both independently and as part of a distributed team.
  • Strong sense of ownership and urgency, with a commitment to delivering high-quality, polished products.
  • Proven ability to quickly adapt to new technologies and a commitment to continuous learning.
  • Creative and analytical mindset for tackling complex technical challenges and driving innovative solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and secure web applications from end-to-end.
  • Implement user interface and user experience (UI/UX) designs using front-end technologies.
  • Develop and manage back-end services and APIs (Application Programming Interfaces).
  • Integrate front-end components with back-end logic.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and efficient code.
  • Perform testing and debugging to ensure high performance and responsiveness of the application.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver new features.
  • Maintain code integrity and organization, and participate in code reviews.
  • Stay up-to-date with new technologies and industry best practices.


Why Join Us?

  • You love building real, meaningful features—not just completing tickets
  • You want autonomy and real ownership.
  • You enjoy solving problems across frontend, backend, and database.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, iterative environment.
  • You care about clean code and great user experience.
  • We offer Unlimited Vacations Policy.
  • You want a Real 100% remote work (we don't have physical offices to go to \"once per week\").
  • You want Flex-time and Manage your schedule Policy (we are looking for teamwork and results).
  • You want an opportunity to work closely with leadership and gain cross-functional experience in a fast-growing company at the forefront of the AI revolution.


If you're passionate about AI and innovation and want to be at the forefront of the conversational AI revolution and join a team in the first few years of a great journey, apply today! We might have a seat for you on our rocketship!

title: Power Electronics PCB Design Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Power Electronics PCB Design Expert em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Power Electronics PCB Design Expert to design, evaluate, and validate power electronic circuits and PCB layouts. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in power supply design, component selection, PCB layout best practices, and design verification methodologies.


Key Responsibilties

  • Design power electronic circuits including DC-DC converters, LDOs, AC-DC power supplies, and automotive power systems.
  • Create schematics and PCB layouts using tools such as KiCad, Altium, or equivalent.
  • Select components based on electrical, thermal, and reliability requirements.
  • Perform design analysis for efficiency, ripple, thermal performance, EMI, and manufacturability.
  • Generate manufacturing deliverables including BOMs, Gerber files, and assembly data.
  • Validate designs through simulations, calculations, DRC/LVS checks, and design reviews.
  • Develop and apply verification frameworks for schematic and PCB layout quality, including specification compliance, topology validation, component derating, DFM, thermal integrity, and power integrity.


Required Skills

  • Strong understanding of power electronics fundamentals (DC-DC converters, switching regulators, LDOs, power components) .
  • Hands-on experience with schematic design and PCB layout.
  • Proficiency with PCB design tools (KiCad, Altium, or similar) .
  • Ability to interpret datasheets and validate component selection.
  • Knowledge of DRC, manufacturability, grounding, routing, and EMI best practices .


Preferred Skills

  • Experience with AC-DC power supply design and automotive electronics.
  • Familiarity with thermal analysis, power integrity, and simulation tools.
  • Experience developing hardware validation or evaluation frameworks.
  • Basic scripting experience (Python/terminal-based verification workflows).


Qualification

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in power electronics and PCB design .


Key Compentencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Attention to detail and design quality.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate across teams.
  • Effective communication skills.

Estamos buscando um(a) editor(a) de vídeo para integrar a equipe de um canal de YouTube com produção recorrente de vídeos longos (entre 30 e 40 minutos).


Remuneração: R$ 6.500,00 mensais


A vaga é remota e fixa, com demanda média de 1 vídeo por semana.


O(a) profissional receberá o material bruto das gravações, além das artes de abertura, encerramento e demais elementos gráficos já produzidos, e será responsável pela edição e finalização do vídeo até a entrega pronta para publicação.


Responsabilidades:

• assistir e organizar o material bruto;

• fazer o corte e a montagem do vídeo;

• pesquisar e inserir imagens de arquivo quando necessário;

• gerar, revisar, corrigir e queimar as legendas no vídeo final;

Buscamos alguém com experiência em vídeos longos para YouTube, bom senso narrativo, atenção a ritmo, clareza e acabamento. É importante ter autonomia para conduzir o processo de edição do início ao fim, seguindo a linguagem do canal e mantendo consistência nas entregas.


Requisitos:

• experiência comprovada com edição de vídeos longos;

• portfólio com trabalhos anteriores;

• domínio de software profissional de edição;

• equipamento próprio;

• disponibilidade compatível com uma rotina semanal de produção;

• familiaridade com vídeos de entrevista, debate, opinião ou conteúdo jornalístico/documental;

• experiência com pesquisa de imagens de arquivo;

• atenção a legendas, acabamento e acessibilidade;

• noções de ritmo narrativo para retenção em vídeos longos.


A contratação é remota, com flexibilidade de horário, mas exige disponibilidade consistente para uma entrega semanal.


Para se candidatar, envie:

1. portfólio;

2. breve descrição da sua experiência;

3. softwares que utiliza;

4. disponibilidade semanal;

title: Consultor de Pré Vendas (SDR)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor de Pré Vendas (SDR) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Nós somos a EasyJur e estamos mudando o mundo! A EasyJur é uma Legaltech com missão de revolucionar a forma de trabalho do advogado por meio de inteligência humana e artificial. Todo advogado que adota o #easyjur como solução central percebe rapidamente os benefícios da transformação digital. Acreditamos que pensar e fazer diferente é o caminho para construir não apenas um software jurídico — mas um mundo mais justo. Seja um #Easyforce com a gente!


O que a gente espera de você?

Buscamos um SDR Sênior que queira ser protagonista em um time comercial de alta performance estruturado em Sales PODs. A pessoa ideal tem visão de processo, opera com autonomia, e entende que prospecção de qualidade não é volume e sim diagnóstico.

Você será responsável por construir e qualificar pipeline com precisão, garantindo que cada lead que avança para o Closer chegue com contexto real, dor mapeada e próximo passo claro.


No seu dia a dia, você vai:

﻿

  • Executar cadências de qualificação de inbound, segmentadas por perfil de ICP e nível de consciência do lead, utilizando o HubSpot.
  • Conduzir as primeiras conversas com foco em diagnóstico inicial: mapear Situação e Dor do potencial cliente utilizando o framework SPICED como guia de qualificação.
  • Operar e alimentar agentes de comunicação (IA) integrados ao fluxo de prospecção, garantindo que a automação potencialize a abordagem consultiva.
  • Registrar e manter a higiene dos dados no HubSpot em tempo real, documentando interações, estágio do lead e sinalizadores de qualificação com rigor.
  • Realizar o handoff qualificado para o Closer com o SPICED parcialmente preenchido e o contexto necessário para uma reunião de Discovery de alto nível.
  • Atuar em colaboração direta dentro do Sales POD, participando de dailies com o Closer e o CSM para destravar oportunidades e alinhar estratégias de abordagem.
  • Contribuir com a construção e melhoria contínua dos scripts, cadências e critérios de descarte, com base em dados e feedback do funil.


O que buscamos de conhecimento técnico?


  • Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência em SDR ou Inside Sales B2B.
  • Familiaridade com o framework SPICED (ou metodologias de vendas baseadas em impacto como MEDDIC, MEDDPICC) e mentalidade diagnóstica antes de prescrever.
  • Domínio operacional do HubSpot: gestão de sequências, propriedades de contato, leadscore e relatórios de funil.
  • Experiência ou abertura real para operar com agentes de IA/automação de comunicação integrados ao processo de prospecção.
  • Capacidade de argumentação consultiva: entender o negócio do lead o suficiente para qualificar com precisão, não apenas agendar reunião.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com clareza, objetividade e capacidade de gerar interesse genuíno no primeiro contato.
  • Compreensão de métricas de funil SaaS: MQL, SAL, SQL, taxa de conversão por etapa e ciclo médio de vendas.


O que gostaríamos, porém não é obrigatório:


  • Experiência com SaaS jurídico ou vendas para o mercado de escritórios de advocacia e departamentos jurídicos.
  • Familiaridade com a estrutura de trabalho em Sales PODs ou squads ágeis.
  • Conhecimento sobre OKRs e como o resultado individual conecta às metas do time.


O que você pode esperar de nós:


  • Um time que opera com metodologia real: POD estruturado e cultura de melhoria contínua baseada em dados.
  • Autonomia com responsabilidade, você vai ter espaço para propor, testar e iterar.
  • Ambiente de alta performance onde o crescimento individual é tanto uma expectativa quanto um investimento da empresa.
  • Acesso a tecnologia de ponta no processo comercial, incluindo IA integrada ao fluxo de trabalho.


Benefícios:


  • Programa EasyFamily
  • Programa Saúde e bem estar - Plano de saúde, plano odontológico, atividade física e apoio psicológico;
  • Apoio internet backup (Remotos)
  • Day off em seu aniversário;
  • Bônus por indicação de novos colaboradores e/ou prestadores de serviços.
  • Bolsa de 50% para curso de inglês;
  • Bolsa para especializações e estudos;
  • Plano de desenvolvimento e crescimento;
  • Possibilidade de contrato stock options;

title: Talent Quality Auditor - Remote Work
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Quality Auditor - Remote Work em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Talent Quality Auditor position involves ensuring quality and consistency across all Talent Acquisition processes by auditing key interactions, including candidate calls, screening interviews, and written communications. This role requires reviewing large volumes of operational activity, evaluating performance against defined standards, and identifying both individual and systemic areas for improvement. You'll maintain high-quality hiring standards, analyze audits in detail, identify patterns and performance risks, and document findings with high accuracy while collaborating with stakeholders to drive continuous improvement.


Key responsibilities


- Executing end-to-end quality audits across Talent Acquisition processes, including calls, screenings, emails, and workflows, ensuring adherence to defined standards, scorecards, and KPIs.

- Identifying performance gaps, recurring issues, and risk patterns, documenting findings with high accuracy and detail.

- Proposing adjustments to audit frameworks, processes, and evaluation criteria.


Requirements


- QA Experience: 2+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Auditing, or Quality Control roles.

- Audit Background: Experience auditing operational processes.

- Performance Evaluation: Proven track record evaluating performance based on defined standards, scorecards, or KPIs.

- Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data review.

- Documentation Skills: Strong written documentation skills.

- Independent Work: Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.


Additional skills preferred


- TA Experience: Experience in Talent Acquisition or similar environments.

- High-Volume Environments: Background working in high-volume, fast-paced environments.

- Process Improvement: Exposure to process improvement or quality framework design.



Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

title: Procurement Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Procurement Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Lead Academic Book Procurement & Global Logistics (Brazil)

Location: Brazil (Remote/Hybrid)

Contract Type: Freelance / Consulting Engagement

Industry: Academic Publishing, Book Procurement, Supply Chain & Logistics


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced professional to lead the large-scale sourcing, procurement, and international logistics of used academic books from Brazil and other relevant markets. This role requires a well-connected individual with an extensive network across universities, libraries, wholesalers, distributors, liquidation partners, and academic book suppliers.

The ideal candidate will have proven experience handling high-volume book procurement projects and be capable of sourcing, purchasing, and exporting significant quantities of used academic books (100,000–200,000+ books) while ensuring compliance with all legal, customs, and export requirements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and establish relationships with universities, libraries, academic institutions, book wholesalers, distributors, and bulk book suppliers.
  • Source and procure used academic books in large volumes (100,000–200,000+ units).
  • Negotiate pricing, contracts, and procurement agreements with suppliers.
  • Manage end-to-end procurement operations, including supplier onboarding and inventory acquisition.
  • Coordinate domestic and international logistics, warehousing, transportation, and shipment planning.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian export regulations and destination-country import requirements.
  • Handle customs documentation, permits, licenses, and other legal formalities related to international book shipments.
  • Develop scalable procurement strategies to support ongoing global demand.
  • Monitor supplier performance, inventory availability, and delivery timelines.
  • Build and maintain a reliable network of procurement and logistics partners.


Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience in academic book procurement, publishing, library acquisitions, book distribution, or related industries.
  • Strong network of contacts within universities, libraries, wholesalers, distributors, and book resellers.
  • Demonstrated experience managing large-volume procurement projects.
  • Knowledge of international trade, customs procedures, export documentation, and freight logistics.
  • Experience shipping goods from Brazil to international destinations.
  • Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
  • Ability to independently manage complex procurement and logistics operations.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English preferred.


Preferred Experience

  • Experience sourcing used academic, educational, scientific, medical, legal, or technical books.
  • Existing relationships with logistics providers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and export specialists.
  • Experience handling multi-country procurement and distribution projects.
  • Background in publishing, library services, academic institutions, or book supply chains.


Project Scope

  • Initial target volume: 100,000–200,000+ used academic books
  • Procurement source: Brazil and relevant regional networks
  • Distribution: International shipment to designated countries
  • Engagement type: Project-based with potential for long-term collaboration


What We're Looking For

We are looking for a highly connected procurement professional who can leverage their network to source large quantities of used academic books, navigate legal and logistical requirements, and successfully deliver books to international destinations at scale.


Interested candidates should share:

  • Relevant procurement and logistics experience
  • Examples of similar projects completed
  • Existing supplier and procurement network details
  • Geographic coverage
  • Expected consulting/freelance rate
  • Availability to start

title: Technical Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Customer Success Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you someone who understands a technology solution inside and out — and knows how to turn that knowledge into real value for clients?


We're looking for someone who doesn't fit the traditional mold of Account Manager or Technical Support. We need both at once: a technical consultant who speaks the client's language, understands their operations, and knows exactly how our platform can grow their business.

This role is not primarily focused on acquiring new clients. Your mission will be to deepen, expand, and maximize the value our current clients get from the platform — through upselling, cross-selling, and long-term consultative relationships.


ABOUT THE COMPANY


A SaaS company in regional expansion, delivering high-impact solutions for enterprise clients across LATAM. The platform supports complex operational processes and integrates with clients' existing systems to generate measurable business value.

Agile team, high-performance culture, and a product that keeps evolving. This role is central to that growth.


YOUR MISSION


You will be the strategic link between the company and its most important clients. Your job is to make sure each client not only uses the platform well, but continuously discovers new ways it can transform their business.

From day one, you'll operate as a trusted technical consultant: someone who understands the solution's architecture, knows the integration possibilities, and can articulate expansion opportunities in the client's language.


WHAT YOU'LL DO


Account Growth

–   Identify and execute upselling and cross-selling opportunities within the existing client base.

–   Build account growth plans: understand each client's roadmap and align it with our product evolution.

–   Manage renewal and expansion cycles with a long-term focus.

Applied Technical Consulting

–   Develop a deep understanding of how our platform works: architecture, modules, APIs, and integrations.

–   Analyze client systems (ERP, BMS, CMMS, CRM, and others) to identify integration and expansion opportunities.

–   Participate in technical meetings, discovery sessions, and consultative presentations alongside product and engineering teams.

Strategic Client Relationships

–   Maintain high-level relationships with technical, operational, and executive stakeholders within each account.

–   Be the client's go-to consultative reference: the person they call when they want to evolve, not just when they have a problem.

–   Monitor account health (adoption, usage, ROI) and act proactively on risk or opportunity signals.

Internal Collaboration

–   Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Support teams to ensure a cohesive client experience.

–   Translate client needs into the product roadmap in a structured, evidence-based way.

–   Maintain pipeline, forecast, and expansion metrics in CRM with rigor and consistency.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


Experience

–   4 to 7 years in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or Technical Consulting roles at SaaS or technology companies.

–   Proven track record managing enterprise accounts through expansion and renewal cycles.

–   Demonstrable history of upselling and cross-selling driven by technical knowledge and consultative relationships.

–   Experience in LATAM markets is highly valued.

Technical Profile (core requirement)

–   Background in Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Telecommunications, or related fields — or a commercial profile with a solid, demonstrable technical foundation.

–   Genuine ability to understand how software works: modules, integrations, APIs, and data flows.

–   Experience engaging with client system architectures and evaluating integration scenarios.

–   Comfortable moving between technical conversations (IT, Engineering) and executive ones (C-Level, Operations).

Language Requirements

–   Spanish fluency is mandatory — all current clients operate in Spanish across LATAM.

–   English proficiency is required for this role.

–   Portuguese is a plus.

Nice to Have

–   Experience with SaaS solutions, IoT, smart buildings, analytics, digital platforms, or operational transformation.

–   Industry knowledge in retail, airports, hospitality, real estate, or large physical operations.

–   Familiarity with CRM tools and Customer Success methodologies (Gainsight, ChurnZero, HubSpot, or similar).


WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO...

–   Sells from expertise, not from a catalog.

–   Sees client success as their own performance metric.

–   Is curious, analytical, and energized by complex problems.

–   Can build both technical and commercial trust simultaneously.

–   Thrives in dynamic environments with real autonomy and high standards.


WHAT THIS OPPORTUNITY OFFERS

–   A strategic role with direct impact on company growth.

–   Work with an innovative SaaS platform in active regional expansion.

–   Direct collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Leadership teams.

–   Agile, collaborative culture focused on high performance.

–   Real space for professional growth and career development across LATAM.


Interested?

If your career has combined technical knowledge with commercial impact — if you understand how software works from the inside and know how to translate that into client value — we'd love to meet you.

Apply and tell us: how have you helped a client grow by getting more out of the technology they already had?

description:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsável por garantir a estabilidade e integração das plataformas de monitoramento e observabilidade em ambiente crítico.

Soluções de monitoração e integração multi-sistemas, assegurando alta disponibilidade, performance e confiabilidade dos serviços.

- Implementar, administrar e otimizar ambientes de Zabbix e Grafana em larga escala, garantindo coleta, análise e visualização de métricas.

- Capacidade de documentação técnica e versionamento de código.

- Experiência com Elastic Stack, NetBox, APM ou soluções correlatas.

- Conhecimentos em Python, JavaScript, Bash ou Go para automações customizadas.

- Atuação anterior em times SRE, Tools, NOC ou DevOps.

- Mentalidade voltada à confiabilidade, automação e melhoria contínua (Kaizen).

- Capacidade analítica e raciocínio lógico avançado.

- Clareza na comunicação técnica com times internos e clientes.

- Comprometimento com a estabilidade, qualidade e eficiência operacional.

description:

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Process Documentation Expert position focuses on serving as the knowledge extraction and translation expert for the organization. This role involves conducting discovery sessions with busy stakeholders, asking the right questions to capture complete process information in single sessions, and transforming that knowledge into documentation so clear that new employees can follow it perfectly on their first try while owning the entire documentation lifecycle from discovery to delivery.


Key responsibilities


- Conducting discovery sessions with cross-functional stakeholders including analysts, managers, and leads to extract complete process information through structured questioning, ensuring all necessary details are captured in single sessions to minimize rework and follow-up meetings.

- Creating comprehensive process documentation including step-by-step guides, workflows, checklists, and decision trees using clear, concise language that enables new team members to execute processes independently without additional clarification.

- Designing visual process maps and flowcharts using tools like Miro, Lucidchart, or Draw.io to transform complex operational workflows into simple, easy-to-follow diagrams that enhance understanding and reduce execution errors.

- Maintaining and versioning the TQE-Docs repository by uploading finalized documentation to Confluence, ensuring consistency and standardization across all process documents, and keeping the knowledge base updated as processes evolve.

- Validating documentation accuracy by reviewing process guides with subject matter experts and end-users, incorporating feedback efficiently, and ensuring documentation works correctly for first-time users without requiring multiple revision cycles.


Requirements


- Documentation Experience: 2-5 years of experience in process documentation, business analysis, or operational excellence roles.

- Complex Process Documentation: Proven track record documenting complex operational processes and workflows.

- Stakeholder Collaboration: Experience working with cross-functional teams including managers, analysts, and leads to extract process knowledge effectively.

- Knowledge Management: Background in creating documentation for knowledge management systems such as Confluence, Notion, or SharePoint.

- Technical Proficiency: Advanced skills in Confluence, Google Docs, and Microsoft Office Suite.

- Project Management Tools: Familiarity with project management platforms such as Asana, Jira, or Monday.com.

- Visual Content Creation: Experience with visual content creation tools such as Figma, Canva, or PowerPoint advanced features.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.


Additional skills preferred


- Industry Experience: Background in HR/Talent Acquisition operations or recruiting support environments.

- Diagramming Expertise: Advanced proficiency in diagramming tools such as Miro, Lucidchart, Draw.io, or similar workflow/process mapping platforms.

- Visual Design Skills: Ability to create flowcharts, swimlane diagrams, decision trees, and workflow visualizations.


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Frontend Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Frontend Engineer – Robotics & Autonomous - Based in Abu Dhabi - Relocation required.

95K-105K Euro's Tax Free plus amazing benefits


Robotics, UAV Systems & Real-Time Operational Platforms

Abu Dhabi | Full Relocation Support | Tax-Free Salary | Excellent Family Benefits


We are looking for Front End Dev - Mid Level

With

ideally - Low-latency browser video experience, especially WebRTC/RTP-style streaming, overlays or live video monitoring.

Also Ideally Rotobotics/UAV/Mission Control experience

+ VUE, Typescript + PNPM

Also ideally Maps & Telemetry experience


Role Snapshot


A high-impact Frontend Platform Engineer role across robotics, UAV and autonomous systems. You will work on real-time, operator-facing platforms covering mission planning, live maps, telemetry, video interfaces, geolocation and device management.


The key focus is frontend platform architecture: TypeScript, Vue, pnpm workspaces, reusable packages, clean package boundaries and scalable multi-application frontend systems.


Key Areas of Ownership


• Frontend architecture across multiple applications, shared packages and reusable platform capabilities. • Clear package boundaries between app logic, feature modules, shared UI, composables and platform code.

• TypeScript/Vue development for operational dashboards, mission planning, maps, telemetry, video and device control.

• Real-time operator interfaces using WebSockets, event-driven data flows and frequently updated mission data. • Map-heavy workflows including geolocation, layers, zones, waypoints, device markers and mission visualisation. • Reusable UI components, themes, controls, layouts, package exports and pnpm workspace practices.


Core Skills Needed


• Strong TypeScript frontend engineering with Vue, ideally Vue 3 and the Composition API.

• Solid component-based development, routing, application state, API/data integration and modern build tooling such as Vite.

• Practical pnpm workspace experience and confidence working with shared frontend packages or monorepo-style structures.

• Experience integrating WebSocket-based data and building reliable real-time or frequently updating user interfaces.

• Exposure to geospatial UI, markers, layers, zones, spatial data, telemetry dashboards or video-heavy browser interfaces.

• Clean, maintainable coding style with testing, linting, type checking, code reviews and clear documentation habits.


Strong Advantages


• Experience owning larger frontend systems with multiple applications, reusable packages and platform standards.

• Knowledge of modular frontend architecture, typed package interfaces, dependency boundaries and feature exports.

• Background in design systems, shared component libraries, reactive programming, observables or event-streamed data.

• Domain exposure to robotics, UAVs, autonomous systems, mission planning, command-and-control, telemetry or device management.

• Low-latency browser video experience, especially WebRTC/RTP-style streaming, overlays or live video monitoring.


Why It Stands Out


This is not another “build a few screens” frontend role. It offers real platform ownership in a robotics and UAV environment where frontend engineering shapes how operators work with live maps, video, telemetry and mission data.


Based in Abu Dhabi, with full relocation support, excellent family benefits and a tax-free salary package.


Benefits


Tax Free Salary

X2 First Month Salary

Private Healthcare + Dental for you + any family

30,000 AED education allowance per child – (upto 3 children – 2yrs old to 18yrs old)

Free Lunch

Free flights out and home once a year


Interview Process

2 Technical Interviews

1 Tech Test

Security Clearance (takes 4 weeks)

Then offer
